opportunities.name: Postgraduate Studentships (MPhil and PhD)
eligibility_clues: Available to qualified full-time research postgraduate students
MPhil and PhD
Payable during the normative period of study
Studentship results are announced together with admission offers
Full-time research postgraduate programme applicants are automatically considered for Postgraduate Studentships (PGS) by their programme's Graduate Division. No separate application is needed.
Handbook: full-time students within the normative study period; M.Phil. and Ph.D. (pre-candidacy) at PGS-1; Ph.D. (post-candidacy) at PGS-2
Mathematics MPhil-PhD lists Computational Mathematics among fields of specialization
Part-time students are not eligible for this studentship
opportunities.amount: Annual studentship for 2026-27 is HK$229,200 (approx. US$29,400)
opportunities.amount_note: Printed as the 2026-27 annual studentship. The page does not print a 2027/28 figure or a monthly rate, and it does not print separate HKD amounts for PGS-1 and PGS-2. The postgraduate booklet also prints '2026–2027 annual stipend: HK$229,200' and 'Guaranteed throughout normative study period.'
opportunities.deadline_note: Studentship results are announced together with admission offers. How to Apply prints 'Applications open on 1 September 2026.' The MPhil-PhD in Mathematics page prints Main Round: 1 December 2026 and Clearing Round: 31 March 2027.
opportunities.match_rationale: University-wide postgraduate studentship for full-time MPhil and PhD, including Mathematics and its Computational Mathematics field. Local students are not excluded. It is considered with the admission offer for the round that opened on 1 September 2026. The only printed stipend year is 2026-27.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Tied to admission offers for the round open from 1 September 2026. Mathematics 2027/28 main round deadline is 1 December 2026. Printed rate year is 2026-27.
restrictions: Pre-candidacy PhD students who have not fulfilled candidacy within 24 months full-time equivalent can have the studentship stopped at the 25th month until candidacy is fulfilled

opportunities.name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS)
eligibility_clues: Join us in the 2027-28 academic year
PhD programmes across eight Faculties, including Science

Applicants must meet CUHK's admissions criteria and demonstrate academic excellence, research ability and potential, communication and interpersonal skills, leadership abilities, and cultural diversity
Select up to two programmes
Starting from the 2020-21 intake, PhD candidates nominated by CUHK but not selected for HKPFS are offered a regular PhD place with the CUHK Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship
Graduate School FAQ discusses local HKPFS recipients and the local tuition waiver
Mathematics is an eligible PhD programme on the MPhil-PhD in Mathematics page
opportunities.amount_note: Printed under Stipend, up to HK$1.38 Million (approx. US$176,620) during the normative study period. Also printed: Conference and Research-related Travel Allowance HK$14,400 (approx. US$1,850) per year, up to HK$87,600; Tuition Fee Waiver up to HK$198,000; Lodging Award up to HK$100,000; financial assistance Over HK$1.81 Million (~USD$232,420). The Mathematics department HKPFS page prints a different annual stipend of HK$240,000 and travel allowance of HK$10,000; those older figures are not used.
opportunities.deadline_note: CUHK Application Deadline. RGC Application Deadline on the same page: 1 Dec 2026 at 12:00nn, Hong Kong Time (GMT + 8 hours). The admissions FAQ still prints 1 December 2025; that date was not used.
opportunities.match_rationale: Explicit 2027-28 PhD fellowship with an annual stipend, open to Mathematics. Local recipients are contemplated on the Graduate School FAQ. It is a competitive fellowship rather than the baseline postgraduate studentship, and it does not cover MPhil.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Explicitly the 2027-28 academic year.
restrictions: Initial application must be filed with the RGC before the CUHK application

opportunities.name: CUHK Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship Scheme
eligibility_clues: Targets the most brilliant candidates seeking full-time PhD admission at CUHK

Qualifying criteria may include a cumulative GPA of at least 3.5/4.0 or equivalent, academic/research awards, impactful publications, strong reference letters, or a PhD offer from a top-tier university for the same intake
Candidates applying to CUHK's full-time PhD programmes through the Online Application System by the specified deadlines are automatically considered
No separate application is required
HKPFS nominees not selected by the RGC are offered a regular PhD place with this scholarship
opportunities.amount_note: Distributed as HK$40,000 in the first year and HK$20,000 each in the second and third years, subject to satisfactory academic progress. The same page also prints annual studentships of HK$229,200 (approx. US$29,400) throughout the normative study period and a Conference and Research-related Travel Allowance totalling HK$30,000 (approx. US$3,846).
opportunities.deadline_note: Automatically considered for applicants who apply to full-time PhD programmes by the specified deadlines. The page does not print a separate scholarship date. Mathematics main round on the programme page is 1 December 2026.
opportunities.match_rationale: Full-time PhD scholarship that bundles the annual studentship with an extra award and travel allowance. Local applicants in Mathematics can be considered automatically, but it is selective and is not the baseline studentship.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Considered with full-time PhD applications for the current round. No separate 2027/28 label on this page.
restrictions: Satisfactory academic progress for later instalments

opportunities.name: Tuition Waiver Scheme for Local Research Postgraduate Students
eligibility_clues: Starting from the 2018-19 academic year, the Government fully waives tuition fees for all eligible local full-time research postgraduate (RPg) students in UGC-funded programmes throughout their normative study period
Non-mean-tested
All full-time RPg programmes are UGC-funded; part-time RPg programmes are not
Students with any Hong Kong visa type (including student, dependent, and IANG) or entry permit are ineligible
Scholarships, awards or stipends which do not aim to cover tuition fees do not affect the waiver
Local HKPFS recipients use this waiver for tuition; the waiver does not become extra cash
opportunities.amount_note: The studentships page says the Government fully waives tuition fees and does not print an HKD amount. The MPhil-PhD in Mathematics page prints 'The tuition fee will be HK$49,500 for 2027/28, regardless of the study mode.' That fee line is not stated as the waiver amount.
opportunities.deadline_note: No application deadline is printed. The admissions FAQ presents it as eligibility for local full-time UGC-funded RPg students during the normative study period.
opportunities.match_rationale: Fits a Hong Kong permanent resident in a full-time UGC-funded MPhil or PhD, including Mathematics. It waives tuition rather than paying a monthly living stipend.
opportunities.intake_relevance: In force for eligible local full-time RPg students throughout the normative study period. Not labelled as a separate 2027/28 competition.
restrictions: Local students only, as defined against student, IANG, and dependant visas
A full tuition waiver from another scheme disqualifies the student from this scheme
